description: .NET version upgrade plan from net6.0 to net10.0 (LTS)

tasks.description: Upgrade ContosoUniversity to net10.0: update target framework, upgrade 4 NuGet packages, and fix source-incompatible APIs in Program.cs
tasks.reason: The project targets net6.0 which is end-of-life. Upgrading to net10.0 (LTS) provides long-term support, security updates, and access to the latest runtime improvements.
tasks.requirements: 1. Change TargetFramework in ContosoUniversity\ContosoUniversity.csproj from net6.0 to net10.0. 2. Upgrade NuGet packages: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore 6.0.2→10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 6.0.2→10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools 6.0.2→10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design 6.0.2→10.0.2. 3. Fix source-incompatible APIs in ContosoUniversity\Program.cs: (a) Line 10 - AddDatabaseDeveloperPageExceptionFilter() is removed in .NET 10, remove or replace it; (b) Line 24 - UseMigrationsEndPoint() API is source-incompatible, update to the .NET 10 compatible usage from Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore 10.x. 4. Address behavioral change on Line 17 - UseExceptionHandler("/Error") has changed behavior in .NET 10, verify and update as needed. 5. Run dotnet restore, then dotnet build and fix all compilation errors. 6. Run existing tests.
